# OPAIJA Character Reference Prompts (Locked)

These are the **canonical, locked prompts** used to generate character reference images via Flux Pro on fal.ai. They are produced by `scripts/generate-character-refs.ts` and consumed by Seedance for image-to-video consistency across all episodes.

**Any artist or pipeline can verify here that prompts match `OPAIJA_CANON.json`.** Anything generated by hand using these prompts must produce a visually equivalent character.

---

## Universal lock blocks (applied to every prompt)

### Style block
> Caribbean Glyph-Cel 2.5D anime style, hand-drawn 2D character illustration on a cinematic 3D background, painterly tropical Caribbean lighting, warm golden hour palette, gingerbread architecture or carnival cloth backdrop, high detail, character sheet quality, full body visible, neutral background fade so character reads cleanly.

### Face rules (NON-NEGOTIABLE — canon §visual_style.character_face_rules)
> MUST follow these face rules: ROUNDED chin (NEVER pointed, NEVER V-shaped), broad African-Caribbean nose structure (NOT narrow anime nose), full lips (NOT thin anime defaults), expressive Caribbean anime eyes grounded in African-Caribbean features, rich melanin skin tone with warm golden undertones.

### Negative block
> AVOID: generic anime face, pointed V-shaped chin, thin lips, pale skin, narrow nose, untextured straight hair, generic cosplay look.

### Format trailer
> Vertical 9:16 character sheet, isolated character on softly lit Caribbean backdrop, sharp focus, no text overlays, no watermarks.

---

## Pose blocks (per angle)

| Angle | Pose prompt |
|---|---|
| `front` | FRONT view, full body, standing in neutral confident pose, arms relaxed, facing camera, even Caribbean afternoon lighting |
| `portrait` | PORTRAIT, chest-up framing, expressive face, three-quarter angle, looking slightly off camera, soft warm rim light, character emotion clear |
| `action` | ACTION pose, mid-fight stance with weapon engaged, dynamic body language, motion lines and rhythm glyphs visible, dust and flambeaux sparks, gayelle arena background |
| `silhouette` *(Marius only)* | SILHOUETTE only — pure black backlit shape against deep purple and silver mist, NO facial features visible, NO skin detail, only outline and posture. Elegant tall figure holding a corrupted drum staff. The stillness is the threat. |
| `back-only` *(Marius only)* | BACK VIEW only — character turned fully away from camera, NO face visible, NO profile visible. Tailored dark coat, near-black with deep purple and silver accents, holding the One Drum staff. Cold white edge light from the side. |

---

## Per-character identity blocks

Every character prompt is composed as:
`STYLE_BLOCK . FACE_RULES . Character: <identity> . <palette> . <accessories> . Pose: <pose> . <special notes> . Signature line vibe: "<signature>" . NEGATIVE_BLOCK . FORMAT_TRAILER.`

## Regenerating identically

To reproduce these refs by hand or via another tool:

1. Open `data/shared-memory/OPAIJA_CANON.json` and pull the `characters.<key>` block.
2. Compose the prompt in this exact order:
   `STYLE_BLOCK . FACE_RULES . Character: <identity> . <palette> . <accessories> . Pose: <pose> . <special notes> . Signature line vibe: "<signature>" . NEGATIVE_BLOCK . FORMAT_TRAILER.`
3. Use Flux Pro v1.1 (`fal-ai/flux-pro/v1.1`), `image_size: portrait_16_9`, `num_inference_steps: 28`, `guidance_scale: 3.5`, `output_format: png`.
4. Save to `public/assets/characters/refs/<character_key>/<angle>.png`.

To regenerate via the script:

```bash
npm run refs                                    # all characters, all allowed angles
npm run refs -- --character kai_baptiste         # one character
npm run refs -- --character kai_baptiste --angle action
npm run refs -- --dry-run                        # print prompts only
```
